paragraphs.text: 在 DSH 中进行模拟交易，支持 A 股和商品期货，本地账本，内置 FTShare 数据源与 K 线，无需购买 API Key 也可使用日K收盘价练习
# Paper Trading: dsh-fft-paper-trading
English | 中文
Open an A-share / commodity futures account in DeepSeek Harness without opening a brokerage account
> DSH ≥ 0.2.0-rc.2 · quotes, trading calendar and K-line built in · ledger stored locally
## What it looks like
*Review page: period statistics, equity curve, fills, end-of-day report and cash flows.*
*Futures page: open long / open short / close long / close short, with contract terms, margin and ri
sk ratio on one screen.*
## Features
- **Everything is priced before you place the order**: type a symbol, side and quantity, and the est
imated fill price, commission, stamp duty, transfer fee, post-trade cash and maximum affordable quan

tity all refresh together — there is no separate quote lookup or preview step.
- **Stocks and future
s, two independent accounts**: both accounts are created automatically the first time you open the p
anel — 1,000,000 CNY of simulated cash for A-shares, 1,000,000 CNY for commodity futures; futures tr

ade in lots, reserve margin, allow same-day (T+0) closing and settle at end of day.
- **One ledger s
hared with the AI**: say “buy 200 shares of 000001 at market” or “review my trades this week” in the
conversation and the model calls the ordering and review tools directly; the panel and the model tr

ade the same account.
- **Order straight from the K-line**: the panel keeps a full K-line chart on s
creen; pick a symbol on the chart and its code is carried over to the trade page. The quotes page le

ts you page through sectors and add the symbols you follow to the shortlist.
- **Build positions in
bulk by weight**: import a `code,weight` CSV, set a budget, and buy up to 20 symbols in one batch; c

heck shares, fees and remaining cash before submitting the whole batch.
- **Reviews that reconcile**
: equity curve, maximum drawdown, fill statistics, end-of-day report and cash flows, with returns al

ready excluding deposits and withdrawals.
- **Practice without an API key**: the free tier quotes at

the latest daily close; configure an FTShare key to switch to real-time quotes.
- **The ledger stay
s local**: the event ledger is a file on this machine and is restored automatically after a DSH rest
art; the account is backed up before a reset.
## Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Requires DSH `>= 0.2.0-rc.2`. The plugin ships FTShare quotes, the trading calendar and the K-line v
iew, so no separate data plugin is needed.
- The full K-line view needs Python 3.10+ on this machine and prepares its runtime over the network

on first launch; a failed preparation does not affect ordering, positions or review.
- **Do not** in
stall it alongside `@dsh-ft/dsh-fft-bundle` or any other entry package that ships the FTShare data s
ervice: the data service row would be duplicated, and the related entries in the plugin manager coul
d no longer be toggled separately.
## Get started in three steps
1. Open “Paper Trading” in the sidebar and the accounts are created automatically: 1,000,000 CNY of
simulated cash for stocks and 1,000,000 CNY for futures. Use “Funds” in the account header to deposi

t or withdraw at any time.
2. On the trade page, enter a symbol (such as `000001`), choose side, qua
ntity and market or limit, then confirm the preview and submit. A limit order that does not cross re

sts as a pending order and can be canceled under “Orders”.
3. “Review” shows equity, drawdown and fi
lls, “Positions” shows sellable quantity and unrealized P&L; you can reset the account at any time a
nd pick the starting cash (a backup is taken first).
In the conversation, you can simply say:

- “What is 600519 trading at right now?”
- “Buy 200 shares of 000001 at market, with the note: testi

ng T+1”
- “Review my stock trades this week”
## Market data and API keys
Market data comes from FTShare in two tiers:

- **API key configured**: real-time quotes.
- **No API key**: the free tier. Quotes use the latest c
lose — during the session that is the previous trading day's close — and minute bars and the real-ti
me endpoints are unavailable. The anonymous quota is limited: once it runs out, quotes pause. You ca
n keep trading with a hand-entered reference price, and quotes resume automatically when the quota r
ecovers (about 24 hours, rolling).
Configure the API key in DSH under “Settings → Financial Terminal”; request one at <https://ftai.cha
he API key in DSH under “Settings → Financial Terminal”; request one at <https://ftai.chat/ftshare>.
The panel header shows the data-source state (live / free / unavailable / invalid); when quotes are
unavailable it says why and offers “Get API key” or “Retry”. When the trading calendar degrades to “
Monday to Friday”, the panel flags it (holidays then count as trading days, and T+1, pending-order e
xpiry and settlement are estimated on business days).
## Simulation rules and scope
- **Stocks**: a market order fills once at the latest price, with no partial fills; a limit order re
sts only if it does not cross and is valid for the day. Price limits, trading halts, T+1 sellable qu
antity and commission / stamp duty / transfer fee are simulated per A-share rules; when quotes are m
issing you can order with a reference price. Orders placed outside continuous trading are accepted a

nd queued: they fill at the next session's price.
- **Futures**: commodity futures only (SHFE / INE
/ DCE / CZCE / GFEX), and orders are accepted only during the day session (09:00–11:30, 13:30–15:00)
. Positions settle at the closing price at 15:30 and go through the risk check. Night sessions, inde

x and treasury futures, delivery and rollover are out of scope for this release.
- **Scope**: no liv
e trading, no margin trading or securities lending, no options, no Hong Kong / US stocks, and no str
in trading or securities lending, no options, no Hong Kong / US stocks, and no strategy backtesting.
## Data and privacy
- The ledger lives under `paper-trading/` in the local DSH data directory (default `~/.dsh`), one fi

le each for stocks and futures; nothing is uploaded to any server.
- Resetting an account backs it u
p to `backups/` in the same directory first; when the account is locked by a fault, the panel shows

the ledger path so you can export it and investigate.
- For simulation and research only, with no li
ve trading; this is not investment advice.
